All.name: Brawler
All.description: Your golem is built with inbuilt weapons and protection, making it tough and dangerous. Its blunt arms cannot hold delicate objects or manipulate things.

All.name: Soldier
All.description: Your golem is built as a humanoid soldier. It’s versatile and capable of holding weapons and shields in its arms.
All.skills: Two of Athletics, Brawling, Intimidation and Stealth
All.weapons: Simple weapons, shields and one weapon group

All.name: Quadruped
All.description: Your golem is built as a quadruped form, resembling an animal of some sort. It cannot pick up objects or interact with things.
All.naturalWeaponDescription: (PHY + trained), 1d8 + PHY bludgeoning damage. Deadly d6.

All.name: Scout
All.description: Your golem is built as a nimble scout, trading resistance for speed and dexterity.
All.featureOneDescription: Ignores difficult terrain and treats greater difficult terrain as difficult terrain
All.featureTwoDescription: It’s trained in perception and can use your INT as its modifier when making perception checks.
All.skills: Two of Acrobatics, Performance, Sleight of hand or Stealth
All.weapons: Simple weapons and one weapon group
